unattributed_aggregate_claims.description: Pre-Stage-1 README reports 79 parallel reviewers checked 34,070 canonical + 293 unplaced verses, but individual per-verse logs exist ONLY for the 1,218 changed 'verse-review' rows in wording-changes.jsonl (348 'edition-wide' batch sweep rows are automated consistency edits, not contextual reads). Unchanged verses without per-verse logs remain in automated_screening_only.

Pass 1 reports auditing all 34,952 adopted Clem1598-USFX verses (including 687 Genesis diffs, 33 length outliers, 137 negation mismatches, and 50 broad structural native_order_mapping/punctuation_policy range rows in pass1_proposals.jsonl such as Job 13:1-31:40, Sir 30:1-36:28, Jer 25:15-51:64). Only individually named/quoted verses are counted in documented_contextual_read; unenumerated verses remain in automated_screening_only.

Pass 2 reports 34,873 verified + 79 disputed = 34,952 across 70 books. Individual peer-review evidence exists for the 1,035 pass2_verdicts.jsonl entries (single-verse + explicit small ranges + anchor verses) and 24 explicitly named bonus/boundary catches; the remaining unchanged verses have no per-verse read log and remain in automated_screening_only.

Pass 3 ran full-corpus automated typography, archaism, spelling, and quotation-stack sweeps over 34,952 verses / 6,597 notes, plus standalone English-only contextual reads of 41 explicitly named chapters (§3) and 54 Bucket A/B items + named boundary loci (§2). Only those explicitly named chapters/loci enter documented_contextual_read (tagged standalone_english_only); the remaining corpus is automated_screening_only.

Pass 3.5 pattern-expansion sweep logs cite aggregate sets (290 pre-Pass-2 unplaced, 467 restored verses, 16 convers* est/sunt ad, 14 Prophets convers*, 15 dimidi* part*) without per-verse logs for unchanged items. Only the 40 blind samples, 10 verified fix records, 15 named NT Vulgate loci, and Isa 60:5 enter documented_contextual_read.

Pass 4 reports 0 unexplained discrepancies across all 34,952 Latin verses and 118 parallel-map metadata cleanups (P4-LAT-10). Only the 121 rows with explicit native_refs.lat in pass4_reconciliation.jsonl and P4-LAT-01..09 enter documented_contextual_read.

post_edit_reread_audit.methodology: Tracks every native Vulgate verse whose English text was created/restored or modified between 5261e1b6 and FINAL_TEXT_SHA (excluding pure verbatim key-relocations during Pass 2 native Vulgate migration, reported separately) and checks strictly whether an independent documented contextual read occurred at or after the verse's final text-edit SHA. Zero English verse texts changed after Pass 3.5 (1f05ad75); Pass 4 (1fc8f0c3) and Follow-up (FINAL_TEXT_SHA) modified only notes and maps.
